cards.mood: The piece opens with a suspended, meditative atmosphere established by wordless vocalizations, creating a sense of timeless stillness.
cards.palette: A deep, sustained synthesizer pad serves as the harmonic bedrock, present from the very first second to the final fade-out.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Wrapped in the silver mist of dawn
Where the ancient pines stand tall
Shadows dance upon the mossy floor
Time breathes slowly in the hollow.
[Pre-Chorus]
A whisper in the leaves
The spirit of the wood.
[Chorus]
Hold the light of the moon
Falling like snow on the heart
In the garden of stillness
Where the roots find the deep.
[Verse]
Tracing lines upon the stone
Watching the river weave its path
Every petal holds a secret
Every breath is a quiet prayer.
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind hums a song
The earth holds the weight.
[Chorus]
Hold the light of the moon
Falling like snow on the heart
In the garden of stillness
Where the roots find the deep.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The stars are seeds of fire
Sown in the fields of night.
[Chorus]
Hold the light of the moon
Falling like snow on the heart
In the garden of stillness
Where the roots find the deep.
[Outro]
